title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report - Panorra API Go

issues.main_description_html:
Create a Flowchart Architecture Diagram:

Post Creation And Publishing Flow

  • API Init Post (SLIM)
    • This API is used for creating a post draft.
  • API Upload Panorama Post (SLIM)
    • This API is used for uploading panoramas one by one after post initialization.
  • API Add Post Complete (SLIM)
    • This API is used for drafting or publishing a post.

Post Clone And Timeline Queue Flow

  • API Clone Post (GO)
    • This API is used to clone post data after a user publishes a post, from Hasura DB to CockroachDB.
  • API Addition Post (GO)
    • This API is used to store timeline_post queue data in RabbitMQ.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_add_timeline_post
    • This file/function executes inserts into the timeline_posts table.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_add_nearest_post (x)
    • This file/function executes inserts into the nearest_posts table.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_add_latest_post (x)
    • This file/function executes inserts into the latest_posts table.

Get Posts And Feed Flow

  • API Get Posts
    • This API is hit when using flow no. 2 on API Latest Posts and API Timeline Posts to get complete data from the posts table.
  • API Latest Posts, 2 Flow (GO):
    • Flow 1 gets query results from the timeline table and posts table using JOIN TABLE, ordered by created_at DESC.
    • Flow 2 gets query results from the timeline table by retrieving only post_id, then hits API Get Posts.
  • API Timeline Posts
    • Flow 1 gets query results from the timeline table and posts table using JOIN TABLE, ordered by score_updated_at DESC, score_timeline ASC.
    • Flow 2 gets query results from the timeline table by retrieving only post_id, then hits API Get Posts, ordered by score_updated_at DESC, score_timeline ASC.
  • API Nearest Posts
    • This API is used for getting nearest posts by latitude and longitude.

User Block Flow

  • API Block User
    • This API is used for blocking and unblocking users.
  • API ER Block
    • This API is used for updating:
      • Elastic:
        • Counter follower/following for my user and other user.
        • Counter total bookmark.
      • Redis:
        • List blocked users for my user and other user.
        • List suggestion users half for my user and other user.
        • List suggestion users more for my user and other user.
      • RabbitMQ:
        • Queue {prefix}_block_users.
        • Queue {prefix}_unblock_users.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_block_user
    • This file/function executes deletes from timeline_posts, latest_posts, and nearest_posts.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_unblock_user
    • This file/function executes deletes from timeline_posts, latest_posts, and nearest_posts.

Delete Post And Delete User Flow

  • API Delete Post
    • This API is used for deleting single panorama or multiple posts, deleting the file from the server and MinIO server, deleting notifications, deleting collections, and sending the RabbitMQ {prefix}_delete_post queue.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_delete_post
    • This file/function deletes post data from CockroachDB.
  • API Cronjob Delete User
    • This API is used for deleting users when the user has deleted an account and the account is at least 14 days old. It deletes posts, push_notif, notification_web, and connected Panorra accounts on GoThru, inserts delete_container data for deleting Elastic data by cronjob, and publishes a queue to delete the user on CockroachDB.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_delete_user
    • This file/function deletes user data from CockroachDB.

Score And Block Post Flow

  • API Update Score
    • This API sends an update score queue action by suggestion or post activity: view, comment, or like.
  • RabbitMQ Update Score Suggestion
    • This file/function updates suggestion scores.
  • RabbitMQ Update Score Post
    • This file/function updates most popular score and timeline score based on the view, like, and comment formula.
  • API Block Post
    • This API is used for blocking and unblocking posts, setting Redis for my blocked post list, and publishing a RabbitMQ queue for deleting or inserting data in CockroachDB on the timeline_posts table.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_block_post
    • This file/function executes deletes from timeline_posts.
  • RabbitMQ {prefix}_unblock_post
    • This file/function executes inserts into timeline_posts.
  • API ER Delete Post
    • This API updates or deletes Elastic data and publishes the data to RabbitMQ.
  • RabbitMQ Delete Elastic Comment
    • This file/function deletes all reply comment counters on Elastic.
  • RabbitMQ Update Elastic Bookmark
    • This file/function updates bookmark counters on Elastic and updates list bookmarks on Redis.
  • RabbitMQ Delete Elastic Post
    • This file/function deletes post counters on Elastic.

Clone Post Worker

  • RabbitMQ Clone Post
    • This function clones a post after publishing from Hasura DB to CockroachDB.
